description: List recent public Hourkeeper decisions, newest first, capped at 100 (default 25). No authentication required. This is a summary list; use inspect_hourkeeper_reasoning with a returned decision_id for one decision's details. Private evidence and hidden prompts are excluded.

limit.description: Optional number of recent public decisions, 1–100; defaults to 25.
